decision.rationale: An explicit name-null guard returns 400 although name is optional in the contract. No independent same-scenario test or documentation establishes which side should change.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: K04 PetStoreTest is empty (3–5); README only explains setup. Both null-ID and null-name checks are handler context. Seed cats/dogs do not decide whether form-update name is mandatory.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
